property_snapshot.Name: Veil Safe House — Luskan
property_snapshot.Notes: Former Kurth safe house. Inherited when Kurth eliminated. Arms and disguises.

property_snapshot.Garrison: Peri (Veil shadow monk operative, coordinator). Ossian the Mimir (floating skull, former crime lord, criminal expertise consultant, sapphire eyes, continuous detect magic sweeps). Huginn & Muninn (echo-crystal construct ravens, pattern analysis, telepathically connected to 15-20 corvid surveillance network covering 500-ft perimeter). Shadow-monk-trained Veil operatives rotating external watch (2 per shift, concealed on nearby rooftops). Dock Rat child alley observer (11 years old, paid 2 silver/day, signal-stone-through-window protocol). No standing armed garrison — distributed coverage is the defense. Teleport scroll in Peri's wardrobe as nuclear-option extraction (pre-designated Neverwinter arrival point, only Peri and Lirien know).
property_snapshot.Name: Peri's Operations Hub (Dock Ward Warehouse)
property_snapshot.Notes: Northern Crown shadow operations center, Dock Ward, Waterdeep. Three streets back from the waterfront, corner lot where a commercial lane meets a residential alley. Two-story stone warehouse (60x40 ft, 2,400 sq ft per floor), originally built for dry-goods storage by a merchant house that went under during the Spellplague. Acquired through a Drift intermediary — deed held by paper entity 'Southharbor Storage Associates' that traces to nothing if investigated. Ground floor: central planning table (8-ft oak, salvaged Calishite teak, Waterdeep city map with three-handwriting-style annotations — Peri's tight script for NC asset positions, Ossian's dictated notes in blocky Dock Rat clerk letters, ravens' geometric symbols designed by Huginn). Ossian's hovering plinth near SW corner (18-inch polished granite, aesthetic not functional — gives visitors a place to look). Raven perches along east wall (6 iron brackets, viewing ports facing east/south/north). Communication crystal panel on north wall (3 crystals — Veil network, NCF Waterdeep, Dock Ward Security Corp; Ossian's detect magic flags tampering). Peri's weapons rack near doors (rapier, shortsword +1, light crossbow with 40 bolts, throwing daggers, locked chest with disguise kit and three social-context outfits). Alchemical stove NW corner for Calishite black tea (Ossian's 'olfactory nostalgia' insistence). Second floor (8-ft ceiling, partitioned): Peri's quarters SW (cot, wardrobe, writing desk with three leather-bound journals — red threats / blue assets / black intelligence — warded to appear as household accounts; wardrobe hidden panel conceals 2,000gp emergency cache + teleport scroll), archive room NW (6 locked filing cabinets by district, shared analysis table — Huginn wants chronological, Muninn wants thematic, they argue daily), empty 1,600 sq ft training space (shadow monk pre-dawn forms, scuff marks show footwork patterns). Pre-dawn rhythm: 5:00 training, 6:30 raven surveillance report + Ossian criminal-pattern review + team argument = planning, field work with Ossian in Seliara-designed concealed spirit lantern (magical-signature dampened, 100-ft telepathic range). Never unoccupied. Contingency extraction through residential alley to Dock Ward Security Corp safe room 4 blocks NE.
property_snapshot.Source File: Peri NPC sheet; Operations Hub architectural detail consolidated Day 729 audit pass

property_snapshot.Name: Crystal Gardens of New Harbor
property_snapshot.Notes: Geothermally-heated water garden in New Harbor (Dock District). Born from construction disaster — collapsed buildings, volcanic water table. Spring Garden type plaza. 180x120 ft, seven garden islands, central crystal-clear basin, Spring Wall cascade. Kingfisher nesting site. Property values +15-20%. Construction cost: \~101,200 gp. Annual maintenance: \~1,600 gp.
property_snapshot.Source File: chat artifact — Crystal Gardens of New Harbor

property_snapshot.Name: Veil Safe House — Neverwinter Docks
property_snapshot.Notes: Underground emergency arms cache and shelter beneath a boarding house two blocks from the harbour. Three layers of separation from Baen property. Run by Henrick (boarding house owner, unaware). Accessed through chandler's yard exit. Maintained monthly by rotating Veil operative.
property_snapshot.Source File: workshopped in chat — Veil safe houses

records.title: Neverwinter Academy of Natural Philosophy (Devil Academy)

property_snapshot.Name: Neverwinter Academy of Natural Philosophy (Devil Academy)
property_snapshot.Notes: 2,000 philosophical devil faculty disguised as human professors. Cover: Academy of Natural Philosophy. Located at Crystalline Chasm edge, southeastern Neverwinter. 10 platforms over 800m-wide, 1km-deep sealed Chasm. Dark iron thorned-vine bridge architecture. Mainland campus includes Septagon (7-wing lecture complex), Laboratorium, Faculty Terraces (4 blocks, 500 each), student dormitories, Provost's Hall, concealed Senatorum. Three tribute platforms for Arik, Elara, and Selene. Bonsai caretakers: Crucibane (Aesthete devil) and Pip (age 7, Orchard Chapel).
property_snapshot.Source File: workshopped in chat — Devil Academy and Crystalline Chasm

property_snapshot.Name: Collegium Montis Gladii
property_snapshot.Notes: Dual-campus civil-military academy. Waterdeep campus (original, operational, 48 students). Neverwinter campus (River District, expansion, Boston College model). Produces administrators, not soldiers. Receives Schola Ducum graduates. Pipeline for future department heads, sector leaders, institutional directors. 15-minute walk from Devil Academy.
property_snapshot.Source File: workshopped in chat — Collegium and educational infrastructure

property_snapshot.Name: Orchard Chapel
property_snapshot.Notes: Rural agrarian monastery and education compound at the edge of Neverwinter Wood (southern stretch). Co-run by Brother Feldrin (Deneir) and Baen Holdings. Feeder institution for Schola Ducum Integrata. Children enter via Dock Rat graduation, Bloodaxe intakes, Drift recommendations, Veil redirection. Sanctified zone — Veil surveillance ends at perimeter. Revenue: 5,000 gp/year.

property_snapshot.Name: Venetian Bay — Premium Waterfront Development
property_snapshot.Notes: 25 premium townhouses on manufactured land across the Neverwinter River from the Dock District. Pile-driven foundations in harbour-bed clay. Three canals, gondola service. 6,250 gp/month revenue, 100% occupancy, 15-family waiting list. Construction cost: \~285,000 gp. Can expand north upriver. Additional land creation possible around Moonstone Mask island.

records.title: Shield-Copper Plaza — The Comfort Plague Memorial

property_snapshot.Name: Shield-Copper Plaza — The Comfort Plague Memorial
property_snapshot.Notes: First Imperial Scale Crown Plaza. Crater from Arik's destruction of the Gentle One during Comfort Plague crisis. Amphitheatre bowl layout, 120 ft across. 80-foot Gothic clock tower with Hunding mechanism. Brass and quartz clock faces. Radial water channel system in paving. Dark granite bowl, pressmark rim. Copper beech landmark tree. Annual remembrance ceremony.

property_snapshot.Name: Dock District — The Baen Quarter
property_snapshot.Notes: Baen's original foothold in Neverwinter. 200+ housing units (Phase 1 worker, Phase 2 family), Crystal Gardens, Northern Hammer Smithy, Baen Construction HQ compound, NCF at Dock/Enclave border. Dock Ward Security Corp. The azurite stripe marks the boundary. Population: young working families, \~70% Baen-dependent economy. Active tensions: Old Docks vs New Harbor identity, gentrification pressure, unconverted blocks, frame integration ahead.
property_snapshot.Source File: workshopped in chat — Dock District neighbourhood

property_snapshot.Name: Neverwinter Working Docks
property_snapshot.Notes: Pre-cataclysm harbour infrastructure, western bank of river mouth. Wooden piers, fish market, harbour master's office, customs house, boat repair. City property, not Baen-owned. Baen reaches the docks through NMWC clean water provisioning for ships. Fishing families want stone pier upgrades. The independent 30% of the district's economy lives here.

property_snapshot.Name: Baen Northern Industrial Yards (Warborn Production Neverwinter)
property_snapshot.Notes: Original Warborn production facility. Building 3 within 8-tenant industrial park, 1 mile north of Neverwinter on arterial road. 50,000 sq ft, 12 Legionnaire/month + R&D/prototyping. Backup soul furnace (proof of concept from Inevitable City). Forge Master: Viktor Steelhand. Cover: pressmark component fabrication park.

property_snapshot.Name: The Foundation
property_snapshot.Notes: Post-Spellhold replacement. Beneath Temple of Waukeen, Athkatla. Reflection wards + spatial compression. 4 levels. Warden: Magister Orlen Sabathar. Anti-Fenwick countermeasures built in. Cowled Wizard faction patron operates from here.
